title: Requirement graph
description: The graph that Semspec reads. The keys `nodes`, `id` and `kind` are the defaults. A profile can name other keys in its `source` object. The profile gives meaning to every other field of a node.

disclosure.description: Optional. Counts or lists that the producer of the graph reports, for example the nodes that have no parent. The explorer shows the keys whose value is a non-empty list.

problems.description: Optional. A list of problems that the producer found. The explorer shows the length.

kind.description: The id of a kind of the profile.

node.description: A node has an id, a kind and any other fields. A field that the profile names as a parent field or a link field holds a list of node ids. A field that the profile names as a part field holds a list of parts. A field that the profile names as the check field holds a list of checks. A part and a check are objects. Their fields are named in the profile.
